items.heading: Your Manager and Company Pay
items.text: Your manager and company pay for faster, safer output in your existing role. They judge you by whether the work stays accurate, whether private data stays protected and whether others can repeat your method.

items.heading: India Is Not Lagging
items.text: India is not lagging on this. It is leading it.

items.heading: Not Every Task Benefits Equally
items.text: Not every task benefits equally. AI tends to help most where the task is mechanical, repeatable, or a rough first pass, and least where it needs judgment, context, or accountability you cannot outsource.

visuals.heading: AI Helps Most with Drafting

items.heading: AI Helps Most with Drafting
items.text: AI helps most with drafting and editing, first-pass data analysis, meeting summaries, and stitching together repetitive workflow steps, not with tasks that need context the tool does not have.

items.heading: Never Put Confidential, Client,
items.text: Never put confidential, client, or proprietary data into a tool your company has not approved for that purpose.

items.heading: Disclose Your AI Use
items.text: Disclose your AI use to your manager in plain terms; naming the tool and the check you ran builds more trust than staying quiet.
